title: Do not bring back the Audiences (Venn of set operators) chapter for adsmovil-audiencias: the author built it and rejected it
body: On 2026-10-26 the landing had an 'Audiences' chapter (src/scripts/v2/aud.ts, plain scroll) between Seats and DeltaDictum, built from the adsmovil-audiencias achievement. It had a sticky Venn diagram of edad / rubro / localidad; each text step switched the operator (AND, OR, XOR, NOT, then (edad AND rubro) OR localidad), the region filled, 170 illustrative dots lit up and a count followed. The author did not like it, and aud.ts was deleted. The slot it left was CLOSED on 2026-10-29: that seam is now the CRT switch-off and interception (src/scripts/v2/seats.ts -> src/scripts/v2/dd.ts), one continuous scene, and the plain-HTML CV chapter of src/components/v2/Landing.astro went before the close instead (memory landing-v2/cv-chapter). A new chapter there needs the author. The other repos in C:\dev (KEDO, Project-Patriark, Orquesta, IntelliForm, Merchan7…) are not in the dataset, and none gets a chapter unless the author picks it.
not_derivable: aud.ts was deleted with no trace in the code; only the deleted decision log recorded that it was tried and rejected, and the slot's closing is a decision, not code.

evidence.summary: Cited when this memory was saved.
Spike iterations 6–7 (2026-10-26): Audiences chapter built, rejected by the author, aud.ts deleted. Slot closed by the author's choice of the CV chapter, 2026-10-29.
